test_cases.description: Identify the connected workspace and what the connection may do
test_cases.prompt: Which ADS Beast workspace am I connected to and what can you do in it?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Names the workspace, says whether the connection reads only or may also propose changes, and reports the calls left this month.

test_cases.prompt: Audit the campaigns of Nordwind Furniture and list the problems by severity.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Finds the Nordwind Furniture client, returns a health score per campaign and lists critical findings first, with figures in the account currency.

test_cases.prompt: Where is Nordwind Furniture wasting money in its ad accounts?
test_cases.expected_behavior: Lists campaigns or keywords that spend without results with the amount in the account currency, or says plainly that no waste was found or that the data is missing.

test_cases.prompt: Compare the last 14 days with the 14 days before for Nordwind Furniture.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Shows the change of spend, conversions and cost per result by platform between the two periods and names what got worse.

test_cases.description: Prepare a campaign pause as a preview
test_cases.prompt: Prepare pausing the Nordwind Furniture campaign with the highest cost per result and show me the preview. Do not submit it.
test_cases.expected_behavior: Shows a preview of exactly that pause with a preview id and does not submit it; says the change would wait for a person in ADS Beast.

negative_test_cases.description: General advertising knowledge with no workspace data
negative_test_cases.prompt: In general terms, what is the difference between CPC and CPM bidding?

negative_test_cases.description: Personal banking, not an ad account
negative_test_cases.prompt: Transfer 500 euros from my bank account to my supplier.

negative_test_cases.description: Calendar task unrelated to ad operations
negative_test_cases.prompt: Schedule a meeting with my marketing team for Monday at 10.
